title: Yeasty Gooey Argentinian Cornmeal Empanadas
description: A quick-fix Argentinian dish featuring cornmeal and gooey filling, this recipe is perfect for a snack or light meal. It is satvik-friendly and can be made in under an hour.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine cornmeal, yeast, smoked paprika, salt, and sugar.
Gradually add warm water to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of olive oil and a quarter cup of shredded mozzarella cheese in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and cook the empanadas for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
